concerns.text: SC-002 (Zero scaffold overlap) is not explicitly covered by a dedicated verification task. T015c validates the split logic, but there is no task explicitly generating the 'zero scaffold overlap' report artifact required to satisfy SC-002 as a pass/fail gate before training (T016). The spec requires this as a hard success criterion.

SC-001 (Model accuracy > Majority Baseline + [deferred] lift) lacks a dedicated task to calculate and report the specific 'lift' value and the boolean pass/fail result. T017c calculates a check, but the task description is vague on outputting the specific 'lift' metric required by the success criterion text. A distinct task to compute and log the 'lift' value is missing.

SC-003 (Feature importance report >= 20 annotated bits, sorted) is partially covered by T026, but T026 only validates the report exists and has 20 bits. There is no explicit task to ensure the 'sorted by importance' requirement is enforced in the generation logic (T025) or validated in T026. The sorting constraint is a critical part of SC-003.

Plan element 'Top-K Accuracy (K=5) and Prediction Entropy' (Summary point 1) is missing from the tasks. The spec and plan introduce these as primary metrics to handle polymorphism, but no task (T016-T019) mentions calculating Top-K Accuracy or Prediction Entropy. This is a missing implementation for a key methodological update.

Plan element 'Molecular Weight baseline for volume regression' (Summary point 3) is mentioned in T017, but the plan explicitly states it is for 'volume regression'. T017 description says 'Molecular Weight baseline regression logic' but does not explicitly link it to the 'Lattice Parameters' target (regression) vs 'Space Group' (classification). A task to specifically calculate MW baseline for the regression target (Lattice Parameters) is missing or ambiguous.

T018 references 'SC-004' but SC-004 is the 6-hour pipeline limit. The task description says 'if runtime approaches several hours... reduce trees'. This conflates the per-model timeout (which is a mechanism) with the global SC-004. While the task exists, the tag/reference is slightly misaligned with the specific success criterion it enforces (which is the global limit, not a per-model heuristic). A clearer tag or task separation for the global SC-004 gate is needed.
